description: Supabase PostgreSQL database (project: grjsboqkaywpwatvrzmy, region: ap-southeast-1). The mechanical source of truth for all ecosystem data: components, tokens, documentation, observability events, fundi issues, changelog, architecture model. Supabase is the DATA LAYER ONLY. Business logic lives in Cloudflare Workers. No Supabase Edge Functions for business logic. Direct database access is restricted to Cloudflare Workers (via service role key in Worker secrets) and local development.
notes: Source of truth. Direct Postgres connections managed by Supabase connection pooler.
